responsibilities: Ableitung von Handlungsempfehlungen zur Steigerung der Effizienz innerhalb des Unternehmens

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: stellst sicher, dass unsere Produkte höchsten Qualitätsansprüchen gerecht werden
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: No velocity language at all; the only register is quality ('höchsten Qualitätsansprüchen'), though it describes the products rather than the data work, so this is a weak rigour call.
evidence.domain_risk: Ableitung von Handlungsempfehlungen zur Steigerung der Effizienz innerhalb des Unternehmens
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Output is internal efficiency recommendations at an industrial machinery maker, with no financial-reporting or regulatory language, so errors affect business decisions only.
evidence.data_team_maturity: Bei Liebherr in Nenzing entwickelst Du mit einem motivierten Team Technologien von morgen
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: A team exists ('mit einem motivierten Team') and results are moved into production systems, but nothing signals an established multi-team data function, so mid by default.
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: The six responsibility bullets are two-to-five-word generic phrases ('Extraktion von Wissen aus Daten', 'Beschaffung von Daten') with no tools, scale or methodology.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Steigerung der Effizienz innerhalb des Unternehmens
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The audience is the company's own internal operations ('Effizienz innerhalb des Unternehmens'), with no commercial, product or finance focus; internal_data is the closest fit.
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role leads projects ('Leitung von Projekten') but most bullets are hands-on delivery tasks such as data cleaning and data acquisition.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: Machine learning appears as a modelling skill the candidate applies ('maschinellem Lernen'), not as AI coding tools or data built for AI systems.
evidence.testing_framing: No testing or data quality signal.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Data cleaning is listed as a task but there is no testing, data-quality framework or observability language.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: The posting is framed entirely in capability and efficiency terms with no risk register.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The role builds new analyses and moves them into existing production systems, so neither building from scratch nor fixing dominates.
